name: Blood of my Blood
source:
Venture into a dance of shadows in this wonderful mansion, you will live an incredibly terrifying story of love and terror.

[From [url=https://sheila-alamo.itch.io/blood-of-my-blood]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在這座華麗的宅邸裡，穿梭於暗影之間共舞，親歷一段令人毛骨悚然、交織著愛與恐懼的故事。

[來源：[url=https://sheila-alamo.itch.io/blood-of-my-blood]Itch.io[/url]]
